visual_connections.description: Triggers the lightweight Ingest Lambda upon receiving an account update event.
Ingest Lambda queries raw transaction data stored in RDS.
Ingest Lambda publishes batched transaction descriptions to the SQS queue.
SQS queue fans out messages to worker NLP Processing Lambdas.
NLP Processing Lambda writes enriched transaction data and model metadata to RDS.
NLP Processing Lambda emits completed transaction event to downstream Kinesis stream.
